tool.name: Bookmap
tool.description: Bookmap is order-flow software that draws a heatmap of the order book for futures, stocks and crypto. A free Digital package is listed. Real-time futures and stock data is sold separately from the software.
features: Add-on indicators such as footprint, absorption and a trading journal
Delayed US stocks and futures, plus real-time crypto, on the free package described
Replay is limited to some packages
tool.pricing_note: Software package prices were not clearly stated in the page text captured on 11 Oct 2026. The same page says real-time futures and stock data is extra, with examples such as BookmapData at $34 to $79 per month.
